sources.title: CAG Report No. 6 of 2024, Karnataka (school education)

sources.title: 34,000 children out of school in Karnataka, 6,000 in BBMP limits
sources.note: Samagra Shikshana Karnataka door-to-door survey: 34,411 out of school; Bidar 2,609 (highest after BBMP), Udupi 172 (lowest); reasons health, finances, family.

sources.title: Rise in school drop-outs worrying (editorial)
sources.note: State survey counted 70,116 out-of-school children in 2018-19 (14,000 the year before; age cover widened); migration and disinterest cited; district counts include Ballari 5,132 and Vijayapura 4,417.

sources.title: At 22.2%, school dropout rate in Karnataka much above national average
sources.note: Samagra Shiksha 2025-26 review: Karnataka secondary dropout 22.2% (2023-24) vs 14.1% national; Ministry asked high-burden states to run door-to-door surveys.

sources.title: Karnataka records high dropout rate in secondary schools: UDISE data
sources.note: UDISE+ 2023-24: Karnataka secondary dropout 22.09% vs 14.1% national.

sources.title: Karnataka records highest dropout rate among boys at secondary level

sources.title: 82k children quit schools

sources.title: CS orders survey to find school dropouts
sources.note: Chief Secretary order for a dropout survey; mentions SATS 60-day absence rule (per other results).

sources.title: Correlates of school dropout and absenteeism among adolescent girls from a marginalized community in north Karnataka
sources.publisher: LSHTM STRIVE (Prakash et al., J. Adolescence 2017)
sources.note: Survey of 2,275 SC/ST girls: 8.7% dropped out; poverty, work migration, child marriage and school environment linked to dropout (Bagalkot and Vijayapura).

sources.title: Prakash et al. 2017 (LSHTM repository record)
sources.note: Repository record for the north Karnataka adolescent girls dropout study.

sources.title: Evidence brief: Samata intervention to increase secondary school completion
sources.note: SC/ST girls in north Karnataka: highest dropout risk in the state (11% vs 5.8% statewide, grades 8-9); trial found no overall effect.

sources.title: Assessing the effect of the Samata intervention on child marriage and school drop-out pathways
sources.publisher: Journal of Global Health Reports (Beattie et al.)
sources.note: Cluster-randomised trial in two districts by KHPT; mixed results.

sources.title: Samata trial protocol (Bagalkot and Vijayapura)
sources.note: Background cites SSA data: 17% (Vijayapura) and 12% (Bagalkot) of girls lost between 7th and 8th standard in 2010-11.

sources.title: SAMATA Samachara newsletter, May 2016
sources.note: Vijayapura Deputy Commissioner: dropout down marginally, high in summer when families migrate for work.

sources.title: Out of school / dropout children in Dharwad district, Karnataka: a geographical study
sources.publisher: National Geographical Journal of India (Saviramath & Dadugoudar)
sources.note: Field survey plus secondary data on dropout in Dharwad district; causes and measures (findings not read).

sources.title: 150 kids still out of school in Dharwad ahead of new academic year
sources.note: Joint survey: about 150 children not enrolled; Navalgund 53, Kundgol 36; many from migrant farm families.

sources.title: Gadag's heartfelt mission: bringing dropouts back to school one child at a time
sources.note: 'Come, come to school' drive: survey of farms and worksites; 14 in Gadag town, 11 in Ron and 8 in rural Gadag returned.

sources.title: Karnataka police go beyond policing, return 200 school dropouts
sources.note: Shivamogga police 'Back to School' drive: 946 identified dropouts, Bhadravathi highest, 200+ returned.

sources.title: Udupi district boasts lowest number (of out-of-school children)
sources.note: 2013-14 survey: Udupi 1,008 out-of-school children, third lowest in the state.

sources.title: 142 govt schools shut in Uttara Kannada over 17 years
sources.note: School closures and zero enrolment (access/supply context for dropout).

sources.title: 35 govt schools in Uttara Kannada record zero admissions this academic year
sources.note: Zero-admission schools in Uttara Kannada and Sirsi educational districts.

sources.title: 2,151 school dropouts in Mandya district
sources.note: 2013-14 DPI survey: 2,151 dropouts aged 6-14 (1,297 boys, 854 girls); Srirangapatna 443; parental illiteracy, poverty, migration, sibling care.

sources.title: Mysuru has over 2,600 school drop-outs
sources.note: December 2013 survey (counts in the coverage vary: 5,512 identified, 2,855 re-enrolled); about 60% girls.

sources.title: Bleak future ahead: COVID-19 pushes Karnataka's first-generation Adivasi learners off schools
sources.note: Jenu Kuruba and tribal children in Chamarajanagar and Mysuru; ashram schools inside the tiger reserve; meals lost during closures.

sources.title: An investigative study on school drop-outs in tribal settings: three tribes in South Karnataka
sources.note: Soliga, Jenu Kuruba and Betta Kuruba dropouts in Chamarajanagar district (findings not read).

sources.title: Status and problems of Jenukuruba tribal students in Mysuru district
sources.note: Jenu Kuruba students in Mysuru district; culturally linked education overlooked (findings not read).

sources.title: 100 out of 228 dropout children return to school
sources.note: Chamarajanagar education survey: dropouts concentrated in Hanur taluk; poverty and parents sending children to fields.

sources.title: Number of school dropouts falls to single digits
sources.note: Dakshina Kannada dropout decline (details not read).

sources.title: Sharp decline in school dropouts in DK
sources.note: Dakshina Kannada dropout count fell from 7,800 (2001-02) to 132 (2012-13), credited to SSA drives.

sources.title: Stark decline in school dropouts in DK
sources.note: Dakshina Kannada dropout decline (details not read).

sources.title: 90 schools in Dakshina Kannada record zero admissions in five years
sources.note: Zero-admission schools; aided schools converting to English/CBSE (enrolment context).

sources.title: Economic analysis of primary school dropouts in Kodagu district
sources.note: Socio-economic factors behind primary dropouts in Kodagu (primary level, not secondary).

sources.title: Kalaburagi tops state in school absenteeism

sources.title: Azim Premji Foundation field updates (lists 'Who drops out of school: dropout study of Yadgir')

sources.title: Makeshift schools for kids of construction workers

sources.title: MCC begins house-to-house mobile app survey on school dropouts
sources.note: Mysuru City Corporation app-based survey of children aged 6-14.

sources.title: Distress seasonal migration and its impact on children's education

sources.title: Determinants of school dropouts among adolescents: evidence from a longitudinal study in India

sources.title: Diverging pathways: when and why children discontinue education in India
sources.note: Pulled-out / pushed-out / opted-out framework; pull factors above 60% (Andhra Pradesh and Telangana).

sources.title: 700 child marriages in a year: CM pulls up officials
sources.note: Child marriage cases 418 (2021-22) to 719 (2023-24) per the department; district counts appear in related reports.

sources.title: Karnataka has a teen pregnancy problem: 28,500 underage girls reported pregnant in 11 months
sources.note: Adolescent pregnancy counts (a schooling-exit pathway for girls).

sources.title: Poverty, school closure push up child marriages in Karnataka
sources.note: Links COVID school closures and poverty to child marriage.
